_comment: Lab members, rendered on /members/ below the PI band. Each object in `groups` becomes a heading plus a list of people; add a group (Postdocs, MSc Students, Alumni) by adding an object here. Person fields: name, joined (year only; renders as "Joined 2023" under the photo), photo (path under /assets/, blank shows a placeholder), interests [], hobbies [], blurb (self-intro or short quote, shown under an "In their words" label; inline HTML such as <em> is rendered, not escaped), and links {github, orcid, linkedin, email}. Every field except name is optional — omit or leave blank and it is skipped, including the whole icon row. A group with "layout": "grid" instead renders compact cards four to a row, using name, role, years, note and photo; a group with an empty people list reserves blank space under its heading.
